description.value: Original Pho Eatery is a family-run Vietnamese restaurant in Langford's Westshore area, specializing in slow-simmered pho broths made from scratch with long-toasted aromatics, grilled proteins, and hand-prepped herbs. This is one of two locations serving the greater Victoria area, with this branch anchoring a busy suburban shopping corridor on Jacklin Road. Cyclists stopping in can choose from dine-in, pickup, or delivery and will find a broad menu including pho varieties, rice plates, vermicelli, and strong iced coffee.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record matches the Langford location of Original Pho Eatery at 2972 Jacklin Road, confirmed by the website which lists this address with suite #106. The merchandise subpage explicitly states 'yes, we have bathrooms,' confirming washrooms. The website confirms takeout (pickup and delivery) and lists a dedicated 'Vegetarian Dishes' menu section; no mention of bike parking, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other cycling amenities.
concerns: OSM address is missing suite number #106 (website: '2972 Jacklin Road #106'); contact_confirmed address set to true as the street and postal code match.
OSM community field is listed as 'Victoria' but the physical address is in Langford, a separate municipality in the Capital Regional District.
OSM opening hours differ from website hours — OSM shows 11:00 start and 20:00/21:00 close; website shows 11:30 start and 21:00/21:30 close. OSM hours appear outdated.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active Vietnamese restaurant with a live website, confirmed address, and current menu. Straightforwardly useful to touring cyclists seeking a meal stop in the Langford/Westshore area.
enrichment_extras.notes: Two-location chain; the Victoria (Downtown) location at 807 Fort Street may warrant a separate OSM record and directory listing.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu page lists a dedicated 'Vegetarian Dishes' category
